g.text: Dependency rule: arrows only point downwards.
L5 has no project imports; L3 never imports L2 or L0;
infrastructure (L4) knows tables but not job logic.
Inside L0 the direction is fixed: main.py assembles,
routers/* are leaves, and the support modules
(api_support, job_artifacts, api_context) never import a router.
Two deliberate separations: parsing the proxy (proxy.py)
is apart from proving it works (connectivity.py), and
producing a cookie report (cookie_health.py) is apart from
Violations to watch: importing job_manager from
ytdlp_service, or importing yt-dlp types into schemas.
